title: Sky Quarry Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Sky Quarry Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an amended and restated sales agreement for its at-the-market (ATM) equity distribution program, replacing Cantor Fitzgerald with Muriel Siebert & Co. as the sales agent and increasing the aggregate sales price from $4.7 million to $12.6 million. The filing contains no information relevant to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Sky Quarry Inc. (ticker SKYQ) entered into an Amended and Restated Sales Agreement with Muriel Siebert & Co. on April 22, 2026.
The company replaced Cantor Fitzgerald as the designated sales agent for its ATM share issuance program.
Commission rate for the Agent is 3.0% of gross proceeds from each share sale.
Aggregate sales price under the program was increased from $4,700,000 to $12,600,000.
The ATM Shares are registered under the company's S-3 shelf registration (File No. 333-291721).
The company has no obligation to sell any shares and may suspend or terminate the agreement at any time.
